title: Earth-cooled, shipping container underground CA home for 30K
summary: Kirsten Dirksen profiles Steve Rees, who buried two shipping containers to build an earth-cooled, off-grid 640 sq ft home in Northern California for about $30,000, solar included.
why: Recommended as an example of earth-sheltered housing and as part of a channel HN loves for architecture and efficiency.

quote.text: I can't recommend Kirsten Dirksen's channel enough to people interested in architecture, energy efficiency, tiny homes
